proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived the adjacent seven-type sharp minimax expansion with the retained midpoint marker, a width-optimized Dirichlet coefficient, and matching legal-table converse. Citation retrieval was repaired by source attestation; the omitted accepted-bank comparison and disputed score identity were clarified, after which both final panels passed with no findings. tldr: For the full adjacent seven-type ternary fixed-table game, the sharp minimax risk is \(R_n=n^{-1}-C_{\mathrm{ref}}n^{-4/3}+o(n^{-4/3})\). Exact symmetry retains a two-count experiment, including the informative midpoint marker. A bounded two-coordinate score gives the uniform upper bound, while legal fixed-table priors and the weighted marker-score limit give the matching all-design, all-estimator converse. The coefficient is the evaluated minimum over interval width of the first Dirichlet eigenvalue of \(-4d^2/dx^2+|x|/2\) plus the width penalty, and a total computable original-record procedure attains it uniformly.
gap: Published rectangular and binary minimax results do not evaluate the coupled seven-type experiment, whose observed midpoint count carries information about heterogeneity.
